esp_panel_board_init.message0:
initialize display panel %1
basic settings: driver %2 width %3 height %4
SPI pins: MISO %5 MOSI %6 SCLK %7 CS %8 DC %9 RST %10 BL %11
other settings: backlight %12 color order %13 SPI frequency %14
esp_panel_board_init.tooltip: Create an SPI display by selecting its LCD driver chip and assigning the display pins.

esp_panel_board_delete.tooltip: Stop all panel devices and release their resources.

esp_panel_board_ready.tooltip: Return true after the display has successfully started.

esp_panel_has_device.tooltip: Check whether the selected device has been configured.

esp_panel_lcd_color_bar.message0: display panel %1 show LCD color bars
esp_panel_lcd_color_bar.tooltip: Draw the built-in LCD color-bar test pattern.

esp_panel_lcd_display.tooltip: Turn the LCD controller output on or off.

esp_panel_lcd_invert.tooltip: Enable or disable LCD color inversion.

esp_panel_lcd_transform.tooltip: Apply an LCD coordinate transformation. Apply the same transform to touch when needed.

esp_panel_lcd_set_gap.message0: display panel %1 set LCD gap X %2 Y %3
esp_panel_lcd_set_gap.tooltip: Set the LCD X and Y coordinate offsets in pixels.

esp_panel_bitmap_data.tooltip: Reference a C/C++ bitmap array or buffer declared elsewhere in the project.

esp_panel_lcd_draw_bitmap.message0: display panel %1 draw bitmap X %2 Y %3 width %4 height %5 RGB data %6 timeout ms %7
esp_panel_lcd_draw_bitmap.tooltip: Send a raw RGB bitmap buffer to the LCD. Use -1 timeout when the buffer may be reused immediately.

esp_panel_lcd_fill_screen.message0: display panel %1 fill LCD RGB565 color %2
esp_panel_lcd_fill_screen.tooltip: Fill the whole 16-bit RGB565 LCD with one color.

esp_panel_lcd_fill_rect.message0: display panel %1 fill LCD rectangle X %2 Y %3 width %4 height %5 RGB565 color %6
esp_panel_lcd_fill_rect.tooltip: Fill a rectangle on a 16-bit RGB565 LCD.

esp_panel_rgb565.tooltip: Convert 8-bit red, green and blue values to a 16-bit RGB565 color.

esp_panel_lcd_info.tooltip: Read the current LCD frame width, height or color depth.

esp_panel_touch_read.message0: display panel %1 read first touch point timeout ms %2
esp_panel_touch_read.tooltip: Read and cache the first touch point; return true when a point is available.

esp_panel_touch_value.tooltip: Read a value cached by the last touch-read block.

esp_panel_touch_transform.tooltip: Apply a coordinate transformation to touch points.

esp_panel_touch_interrupt.message0: display panel %1 touch interrupt is enabled
esp_panel_touch_interrupt.tooltip: Return true when the touch driver uses an interrupt pin.

esp_panel_touch_button.message0: display panel %1 read touch button %2 timeout ms %3
esp_panel_touch_button.tooltip: Read a hardware touch-button state; returns -1 if unavailable.

esp_panel_backlight_set.message0: display panel %1 set backlight brightness %2 percent
esp_panel_backlight_set.tooltip: Set backlight brightness from 0 to 100 percent.

esp_panel_backlight_switch.tooltip: Turn the panel backlight fully on or off.

esp_panel_backlight_get.tooltip: Read the current backlight brightness percentage, or -1 if unavailable.
